title: Associate / Sr. Associate Consultant — Epidemiology & Outcomes Research
description:
Red Nucleus is hiring a Associate/Sr. Associate Consultant \- Epidemiology \& Outcomes Research to join our global team. This role will be remote.
   

  

 Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 800 full\-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on\-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.
   

  

 At Red Nucleus, we believe in providing a rich working environment that pushes us to innovate in ways that engages our employees to be their best selves. Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community, and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a “Great Place to Work".
   

  

**Job Overview**
 The Associate / Sr. Associate Consultant is a core member of the Epidemiology \& Outcomes Research team, responsible for supporting health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), evidence generation, and evidence synthesis projects across a range of therapeutic areas.
   

  

 This role requires strong analytical and epidemiological skills, along with the ability to independently manage multiple concurrent projects under the guidance of a senior team member. You will contribute to the design and execution of literature reviews and other secondary research, interpret complex clinical, epidemiological, economic, and health outcomes evidence, and supervise junior colleagues on select workstreams.
   

  

 The role requires close collaboration with cross\-functional project teams and direct engagement with clients during meetings, project discussions, and deliverable presentations.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

 Research and Analysis
   

  

* Support the design and execution of systematic literature reviews (SLRs), targeted literature reviews (TLRs), and other evidence reviews, including development of search strategies, screening criteria, data extraction frameworks, and evidence synthesis approaches
* Conduct structured searches across bibliographic databases and other relevant evidence sources; screen literature against project\-specific inclusion/exclusion criteria and supervise junior colleagues on the same
* Extract data in a structured manner, perform in\-depth quality control, critically appraise studies, and interpret clinical, epidemiological, economic, and health outcomes evidence
* Resolve complex data issues, identify key evidence gaps and insights, and summarize scientific data clearly and accurately
* Support qualitative and narrative evidence synthesis across projects, including areas such as burden of disease, treatment patterns, unmet need, clinical outcomes, and other health outcomes evidence


 Project Delivery and Quality
   

  

* Develop and implement strategies to ensure accurate and timely delivery of analysis results
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously with some guidance from senior team members
* Support development of high\-quality scientific and client deliverables, including literature review reports, manuscripts, evidence/value dossiers, abstracts, posters, and presentations, as appropriate to the project
* Participate in client meetings and deliverable presentations, contributing analytical insight, interpretation of findings, and project updates
* Support senior team members in project scoping, methodology development, proposal preparation, and estimation of project requirements


 Team Support
   

  

* Provide guidance and quality oversight to junior colleagues on literature screening and data extraction
* Collaborate proactively with senior consultants and cross\-functional teams to ensure project objectives are met
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, training, methodology development, and continuous improvement of research processes and tools


 Required Technical Expertise
   

  

 Core Skills
   

  

* Sound HEOR, epidemiological, and analytical skills, with the ability to critically interpret complex scientific and health outcomes data
* Strong problem\-solving mindset paired with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proactive, flexible, and resourceful, with the ability to work independently and manage ambiguity
* Excellent team player who is self\-motivated and dependable
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office \- PowerPoint, Word, and Excel \- and familiarity with reference\-management software such as EndNote or equivalent
* Working knowledge of AI tools and their application to research and analysis workflows


 Education and Experience
   

  

 Education
   

  

* MPH, MSc, MPharm, or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Epidemiology, Health Economics, Outcomes Research, Biostatistics, Pharmacy, Public Health, or a related life sciences discipline


**Required Experience**
* 4\-6 years of relevant experience in HEOR, epidemiology, evidence synthesis, or related research within pharmaceutical companies or Life Science consulting firms
* Demonstrated experience conducting secondary research, literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and interpreting complex scientific data
* Experience managing multiple projects concurrently, with some guidance from senior team members

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, caste, sexual orientation, gender, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

title: Business Data Modeler
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Business Data Modeler
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your responsibilities**
 As a Business Data Modeler, you play an important role in creating a shared understanding of Vanderlande's business processes, information, and terminology. You translate business needs and domain knowledge into clear business object models and business data models that support consistent decision\-making and collaboration across the organization.
   

  

 Your primary focus is understanding how business domains operate and identifying the key business concepts, relationships, and information flows that underpin them. In this role, you act as a bridge between business and IT, helping stakeholders develop a common view of the business and its information.
   

  

 You work closely with business stakeholders, data stewards, domain experts, architects, and analysts to capture, structure, and document business knowledge in a way that is understandable, reusable, and future\-proof.
   

  

**In this role, you**
* Engage with business stakeholders, data stewards to create a shared understanding of business processes, objectives, terminology, and information needs.
* Analyse business processes and identify key business concepts, objects, and relationships.
* Translate business knowledge into clear business object models and business data models.
* Improve the quality, usability, and adoption of the business data model.
* Document and maintain business definitions, relationships, and modeling standards.
* Collaborate with architects, analysts, and ICT colleagues to ensure business concepts are consistently represented across processes and systems.
* Support data governance by promoting consistent business definitions, data ownership, and shared understanding of information.
* Promote the use and value of business modeling across the organization and contribute to the continuous improvement of modeling practices.


**Your Skills \& Competencies**
 We are looking for an enthusiastic, curious, and business\-oriented professional who enjoys understanding how businesses operate and who can translate complex information into clear and structured models.
   

  

**You bring**
* A bachelor’s degree in information management, Business Administration, Business Information Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 10\+ years of experience working with business processes, data analytics, information management or business analysis.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand and structure complex business processes and information.
* Understanding of data governance, business glossaries, data ownership, data quality, master data, or business architecture concepts.
* The ability to identify patterns, relationships, and concepts across processes and organizational boundaries.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders from different backgrounds.
* The ability to facilitate discussions, ask the right questions, and challenge assumptions constructively.
* A structured and detail\-oriented way of working.
* A proactive attitude and eagerness to learn.


**Nice to have**
* Experience with business analysis, information analysis, process modeling, or business object modeling.
* Familiarity with modeling techniques such as UML or BPMN.
* Awareness of Data Products, Data Mesh, or domain\-oriented data ownership.
* Experience working in a complex, international organization.
* Familiarity with Agile ways of working.
* Basic SQL knowledge is beneficial, but not mandatory.


**Diversity \& inclusion**
 Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

 Knowledge

description:

title: Cyber Risk Governance & Reporting
description:
Join us as a Cyber Risk Governance \& Reporting at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Cyber Risk Governance \& Reporting, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Managing a large and complex portfolio of cyber risk governance, regulatory assurance, and reporting activities across regions, entities, and stakeholders
* Performing data analysis and preparing responses to support Barclays’ continued compliance with regulatory obligations across the globe
* Strong working knowledge of cyber security, risk management, and regulatory expectations, with the ability to translate complex technical content into clear, non\-technical outputs for senior stakeholders and regulators
* Using collaboration, workflow, and reporting platforms such as SharePoint, trackers, and MI dashboards to generate insights, support decision\-making, monitor delivery, and highlight emerging risks
* Supporting tracking, oversight, and resolution of control issues, including those raised by 2LOD and internal assessments that could impact regulatory compliance
* Driving group\-wide GRC assessments, reporting, and compliance to the Barclays Control Framework to identify control enhancements aligned to regulatory requirements
* Enabling proactive risk identification through thematic analysis, MI\-driven insights, continuous improvement initiatives, and effective stakeholder engagement


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Strong experience in Governance, Risk \& Control within large enterprises, preferably within financial services or a similarly regulated environment
* Ability to generate, analyse, and interpret cyber security MI using qualitative and quantitative techniques to identify trends, risks, control gaps, and improvement opportunities
* Experience with audit oversight, control frameworks, internal assessment activities, and regulatory requirements, including the ability to support evidence\-based assurance and issue remediation
* Ability to translate technical cyber risks into business\-relevant insights, reporting narratives, and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across cyber, technology, risk, compliance, audit, and senior leadership teams.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, and communication, as well as job\-specific technical skills in cyber risk governance, regulatory engagement, reporting, and quality assurance.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune, India.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To provide independent and balanced advice and counsel to senior stakeholders through problem identification, solving and decision making practices.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Provision of strategic advice to Group Executives to support the decision\-making process of business challenges and opportunities.
* Development and implementation of strategic advisory incentives to grow and optimise the bank’s operations, through market research and analysis.
* Collaboration with various stakeholder groups to identify the appropriate strategic direction type to meet the needs of Barclays clients and investors.
* Development of financial models to support strategic recommendations and transactions through financial data analysis, financial projects and considering the financial impact of transactions.
* Management of transactions, negotiations, transaction structure development and post\-transaction integration.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders to maintain client relationships, and develop new relationships to identify opportunities.
* Identification of industry trends, maintain peer benchmarking and developments related to strategic advisory services by attendings conferences, participating in training and conducting market research.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Project Sr Analyst - C12 - PUNE
description:
Organization Overview:
   

  

 We are a dynamic, global, and diverse Organization, with a presence in over 60 Countries; covering all front post execution Operations teams including product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative \& Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of Capital Markets products and services including Fixed Income (FX, Rates, Credit, Muni, Cash and Derivatives) where Citi is consistently a dominant top 3 player in the market, Equity (Cash, Derivatives, Prime Brokerage, Futures, Listed Derivatives, FXPB) where Citi has a significant growth program to continue to build out its capabilities and services; and Syndicates where we support both FI and EQ new issues and IPOs.
   

  

 We take pride and are passionate about our People and our culture. We are invested in our People and their development. We are transforming and simplifying our operating model, creating an exciting environment which encourages diversity of thought and inclusion.
   

  

 Our Operations groups are core to the success of the Markets business and have significant impact across the lifecycle of a trade. We partner extensively with a range of internal stakeholders including Front Office Sales and Trading Desks, Compliance, Legal, Finance and HR; alongside having significant interaction with our external client base, playing a key role in the overall client experience. We have a Client relationship group, dedicated to overseeing the Organizational service performance and strategic partnership for our top tier client base, where we play a key role in supporting our global clients to ensure they have a first\-class experience when doing business with Citi.
   

  

 Our Business Intelligence and Process Re\-engineering group works alongside our Operations teams delivering automation solutions to solve for operational challenges. We partner with Citi’s innovation labs to drive optimization, and overall play a pivotal role in enabling us to transform to achieve our target operating model.
   

  

 Our Technology partners develop and implement a wide range of applications that support the Operations, Change, Design and Implementation groups in providing innovative products and solutions. We have re\-imagined how to provide technology and service in our domain through the alignment of our team vision, culture, and aggressive retirement plan for legacy applications and adoption of a micro\-based containerized cloud environment. We encourage our people to create, explore and be adventurous whilst taking measured risk, adopting safe practices to protect the firm. Data lineage and optimization is core to how we develop our eco system. We are growing our capabilities using artificial intelligence, natural language processing and machine learning.
   

  

 Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast\-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and adopt a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to reduce risk through the continuous evaluation of our controls; to protect our clients, the firm, and our reputation.
   

  

 We work closely with our external global peers, partners, and regulators, and play an integral part in leading an agenda at the forefront to optimize and streamline processes and drive strategy across our industry.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 The Markets Process Engineering team has been formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank, to design and deliver a multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment change execution and a market leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process re\-engineering and low code application development.
   

  

 The Futures and OTC Clearing franchise is an agency business providing trading and clearing capabilities across 40\+ exchanges to our clients and proprietary lines of business such as Equities, Rates, Commodities, FX and Prime D1\. The business is embarking on a strategic re\-engineering of its platforms. This is a multi\-year initiative, moving to real\-time computation, and with ambitious goals to design and deliver a more robust, strategic, well controlled end state for Futures and OTC Clearing Operations.
   

  

 We are recruiting for a Project/Business Analyst to help lead the delivery of strategic initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global, and dynamic change management team, delivering a major Tier 1 program.
   

  

 The role will work in partnership with the Futures and OTC clearing business, global operations teams, technology and downstream areas such as finance and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The core responsibilities of the Project Manager and Business Analyst include but not limited to the following:

title: D&A Architect - Data & Analytics
description:
**Application Deadline:** 
 16 October 2023
 



**Department:** 
 BizTX
 



**Location:** 
 India
   

  




**Description**
**Mission Statement \- BizTech that delivers WOW**
 As a BizTech team we are passionate about our Twinings and Ovaltine brands and we strive to WOW our customers, consumers, suppliers and colleagues.
   

  

 We are proud to be leaders in technology who partner and drive change across our business. This change does not happen in a vacuum, and we support our aspiration with behaviors that embody the ways of working by
 ***being curious***
 to grow ourselves and look to continuously improve coupled with a
 ***build trust***
 mindset. We are excited about the journey ahead and would love you to be part of creating a digital future for TwiningsOvo.
   

  

**Purpose**
 The Data Architect strengthens the impact of, and provides recommendations on, business information that will need to be available and shared consistently across the organization through the identification, definition, and analysis of how information assets aid strategies and business outcomes. The Data Solutions Architect is responsible for discovering the data and analytics requirements for information for all uses and will be accountable for designing and evolving our data solutions, helping us provide a strong technical foundation as well as set of organisational practices for our journey to be a data driven organisation.
   

  

 The D\&A Architect will work closely with our internal teams as well as SI and partner teams on design, estimation and build phases of various initiatives, including Program Optimus to ensure Reporting requirements are captured
   

  

**Scope**
 This role will cover all regional business functions across TwiningsOvo businesses.
   

  

 The role will be based in India, with occasional international travel to other TwiningsOvo offices, including France, Switzerland, Thailand, China, Australia, UK and USA.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Own the blueprint for Twining’s Data \& Analytics Platform and Data Management solutions that enable the complete spectrum of analytics – from classic BI to advanced analytics (ML/AI) based use cases.
* Influence Information Strategy by partnering with leadership teams in business units and leadership teams to provide strategic recommendations to maximize the value of information assets via their creation, access and use.
* Co\-ordinate with ABF/Twinings Security and Compliance teams to ensure new or existing solutions of new and existing solutions.
* Create and own architecture diagrams for cloud based solutions that conform to best practices and the ability to transform this down to implementation phases to be handed over to Engineering teams.
* For both local and global initiatives, provide architectural support to ensure solutions conform to our Global D\&A strategy, with a roadmap and plan that allows us to move from current state to the future state as well as end state
* Support and influence local initiatives with a view of global alignment on technology and delivery.
* Partner with IT Teams globally to understand information challenges across ERP and other systems and own the delivery strategy across all source systems, internal and external.
* Co\-own our charter for being a data\-driven organisation, focussing on delivering technical solutions that drive adoption and self service, creating an empowered user base.
* Build an understanding of future needs, direction, ambition and risks for each BU and functional area and communicate with technical teams to own platform/solution architecture.
* Participate in sprint planning sessions with the project team, aligning dependencies, highlighting risks and estimating efforts.
* Build and maintain an understanding of the analytics technology landscape, researching emerging trends and how to exploit for our business benefit and value.
* Co\-create compelling business cases by:


* Building an understanding of Twinings Ovo value drivers to clearly articulate benefits for projects.
* Helping business partners communicate the solution value to key stakeholders.


* Prototype and co\-design for innovative data \& analytics solutions. Evaluate tools \& tech to enhance platform and solutions.
* Participate in Technology supplier/product vendor sourcing selection activities (RFx processes), and commercial negotiations / supplier onboarding processes (define/refine criteria’s to be considered)
* Support the analysis and evaluation of possible impact of changes to the existing application landscape and organisation and plan mitigation actions.
* Support and actively engage in end to end delivery of Analytics projects from design, build, test and deployment, and transition into BAU support.
* Support test activities by ensuring acceptance criteria are well documented and have the appropriate level of coverage, taking responsibility for the design and execution of test cases where appropriate.
* Work with the wider project teams to enable the solutions to be imbedded within the business through the development of communications and training materials.
* Ensure that all working practices comply with Health and Safety legislation and Twinings policies
* Act as a role model for Twinings Ovo values (champion of BizTech culture, nurture and develop capabilities (Business and Technical)).


**Key Responsibilities**
* Minimum 12 years’ experience in architecting D\&A solutions with a focus on owning the technical framework for the end to end landscape.
* Background in analytics, and familiarity with how analytics/data\-driven organisations embed data as a first class citizen. Deep understanding of the D\&A technology space with a focus on SaaS/Cloud products.
* Problem solving skills, including being able to bring expertise in structured analysis and design and programming skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including influencing skills.
* Able to build strong relationships with key stakeholders in order to truly understand the underlying needs of the business.
* Ability to influence decision making, comfortable with challenging and being challenged.
* Experience of working with teams in multiple locations, and remotely
* Effective conceptualization and pattern recognition skills.
* CPG industry experience
* Experience of working in a fast\-paced international business, comfortable with change and ambiguity. Able to deliver change to the business.
* Thirst for knowledge, questions, seeks to understand and continues to learn. Excited by and keeps up to date with latest Technology developments. Proactively looking outside and proposing ideas
* A self\-manager and motivator, able to prioritise and recognise when ownership and escalation appropriate
* Ability to work in a matrix organisation
* Awareness of Cyber Security and Information Security


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Cloud Environments** 
* Azure experience preferred. Experience of implementing solutions in cloud environments using native/3rd party tools is preferred, including building continuous ingestion and hybrid data lake/warehouse solutions with full auditability and traceability. Understanding of Serverless and SaaS products offered, their strengths and appropriate use cases.
* Azure certifications are beneficial.


**DWH Tools** 
* Snowflake or experience of similar analytics focussed tools like Synapse, Vertica, DB Delta lake etc. Deep understanding of parallel processing methodologies including MPP and shared nothing architectures.
* Knowledge of SAP Analytics technologies (SAP BW/4, SAP Analytics on Cloud) etc. are a plus.


**ETL** 
* Experience with Talend or other GUI based ETL tools, including best practices for performance, monitoring and error logging.
* Experience with implementing hybrid solutions of above with Big data technologies like Spark/DataBricks etc.


**Data Modelling \& Data Lake** 
* Expertise with designing Analytical data models based on requirements. Proficiency in resolving modelling issues like double counting, dimension\-dimension relationships etc.
* Expertise in implementing a tiered data lake with different consumption layers.
* Understanding of various file formats relevant in Data lakes and expertise of creating recommendations based on use case and persona.
* Experience of modelling optimized dataflows in BW/4, including integration patterns with non SAP technologies


**Business Intelligence** 
* PowerBI or equivalent. Experience designing self service models in BI tools that are refreshed and monitored in an automated manner.
* SAP Analytics on Cloud is a plus


**Programming Language** 
* Not compulsory but any Python/Scala (Data Engineering focussed) experience, including modules like Pandas, Numpy, Keras etc. is a plus

title: Risk Analytics - Product Analyst - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \- Delivery Excellence Senior position**
 Within last decade, cost of delivery and Delivery excellence has become the most critical factors to run successful and popular businesses spread around the globe. To support such a dynamic and fast paced IT transformation industry, we are using various cutting\-edge Delivery Excellence models and tools with relentless focus on automation to offer best in class and tailor\-made solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As a part of our global team you will be part of GDS projects as Delivery Excellence management professional. You will be involved in working on challenging problems and creating next generation delivery excellence platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Are you a detail driven professional with a passion for translating business needs into impactful product experiences? Do you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Product team and help shape solutions that deliver real value to our clients and users.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll serve as a critical bridge between the business stakeholders and the development and engineering teams. Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast paced, evolving environment.
   

  

 As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.
   

  

 This is a client facing and user centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end to end, collaborate with cross functional teams, and help bring scalable, user friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the defined test cases, validating functionality, and ensuring readiness for release.
* Support in iterative testing cycles, identifying defects, documenting issues, validating fixes, and performing regression testing as needed.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Serve as one of the primary liaison between business teams and engineering, providing clarifications, resolving requirement gaps, and ensuring shared understanding throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
* Engage with clients and end users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified across applications and infrastructure.
* Control Monitoring / Testing \- Understanding of controls around Business processes, ITGC, Cyber, Data protection and privacy to perform testing of design and operational effectiveness of controls.
* Ability to create process documentation.
* Ability to understand business problems in Risk/Finance and contribute to translating them into solution or product requirements.
* Exposure (through projects or roles) to Risk, Finance, Supply Chain Operations (SCO), or related business functions preferred.
* Demonstrates interest in AI/analytics\-driven Risk solutions and their business applications.
* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Basic exposure to Presales, solutioning, proposal support, or client presentations is a plus.
* Interest in working in tech\-enabled or AI\-led Risk products/solutions environment.
* Ability to support senior team members in product development, go\-to\-market efforts, and client engagements.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global delivery environment with distributed teams.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall 3\-6 years of experience in Risk Advisory (preferably Internal Controls) experience with Big 4 or comparable professional services environment
* CA or Master’s degree in Business Administration or Risk management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI
* Product Management experience with demonstrated ownership of delivering business solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**About The Job**
 We are looking for a Data Analyst to revolutionize how we measure and scale our Partner Ecosystem \& Services Business.. In this role, you won't just build dashboards; you will build intelligent systems. You will sit at the intersection of Channel Operations and Data Science, using Snowflake, SQL, and Python to turn raw data into a competitive advantage.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* AI\-Driven Visualization: Develop high\-impact dashboards (Tableau, CRMA, or Preset) that incorporate AI\-generated narratives and automated trend detection.
* Ecosystem Intelligence: Design and maintain a "Single Source of Truth" in Snowflake for all data (Rebates, Co\-sell, MDF, and Training).
* Workflow Automation: Use AI tools to automate the generation of SQL queries, Python scripts, and dashboard documentation to increase team velocity.
* The ideal candidate is an AI enthusiast who leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate dashboarding workflows, generate natural language insights, and predict partner performance.


**What will you bring?**
* SQL Mastery: Expert\-level ability to write complex, performant queries in Snowflake.
* Modern BI Tools: Mastery of at least one major visualization tool (Tableau, CRMA, Sigma) with a preference for those who have built Streamlit apps or CRMA
* Python Proficiency: Experience using Python for data manipulation (pandas, numpy) and integrating with AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) or Snowflake Cortex.
* AI Integration: Proven experience using LLMs to enhance the data lifecycle (e.g., text\-to\-SQL, automated data cleaning, or predictive analytics).
* Domain Expertise: Previous experience with Channel/Partner/Services (GLS/GPS/TAM) is highly preferred.


**Soft Skills**
* Collaborative Architect: You enjoy working with cross\-functional teams to understand the "why" behind the data.
* The "AI\-First" Mindset: You naturally look for ways to automate the boring parts of data analysis.
* Strategic Storytelling: You can translate a complex "Partner Co\-sell" matrix into a clear story for the Sales Executives.


**Why Join Us?**
* Opportunity to lead the transition from reactive reporting to predictive ecosystem intelligence.
* Budget and support for modern AI tools and experimentation.


**About Red Hat**
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

 Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
   

  

 Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
   

  

 Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application\-assistance@redhat.com. title: Business Analyst
description:
**Company Description** 
 Sun\-Net Inc. (Sun\-Net Consulting) has provided software development and professional consulting services to the power utility industry since 1999\. The company builds software\-based solutions that help electric power, gas, and water utilities improve operational efficiency, reliability, and safety. Its flagship iTOA suite is an enterprise platform for operations logging, outage scheduling and coordination, event analysis, and regulatory reporting. The latest iTOA solution is a highly integrated operations application that can be customized to support utility system operations from long\-term planning to real\-time logging. Sun\-Net’s tools enable critical functions such as outage request planning, disturbance and forced outage logging, switching program management, and communication and reporting to ISO/RTO and NERC.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Sunnet is looking for a hands\-on Business Analyst with 2–3 years of experience to support the delivery of software projects. This role is well suited to someone in the early stages of their Business Analysis career who enjoys translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements and working closely with development and QA teams.
 



 You will primarily conduct gap analyses, create and maintain user stories and tasks, document bugs, clarify requirements, and follow up with delivery teams to help keep work progressing smoothly.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work with stakeholders to understand business needs, current processes, and desired outcomes.
* Conduct gap analysis to identify differences between current and required functionality or processes.
* Translate business requirements into clear user stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.
* Log and document bugs with sufficient detail for development and QA teams.
* Maintain and refine the product backlog in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
* Follow up with developers on requirements, open questions, dependencies, and delivery progress.
* Coordinate with the QA team to clarify expected behavior, support test planning, and assist with defect resolution.
* Participate in requirement discussions, backlog\-refinement sessions, sprint planning, reviews, and other delivery meetings.
* Help identify requirement gaps, risks, and potential blockers early in the delivery cycle.
* Ensure requirements and work items remain accurate and up to date throughout development and testing.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* **2\-3 years** 
 of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within a software or technology environment.
* Practical experience conducting gap analysis and documenting business and functional requirements.
* Strong experience writing user stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, and bug reports.
* Good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile ways of working.
* Experience working closely with developers and QA professionals.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good organizational and follow\-up skills, with attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple work items and priorities in a delivery\-focused environment.
* A collaborative, proactive, and problem\-solving mindset.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Experience using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with process mapping, workflow documentation, and basic wireframing.
* Experience supporting web, mobile, enterprise, or digital\-transformation projects.
* A degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline is an advantage.



  





**What we are looking for?** 




 We are looking for someone who is comfortable working at an execution\-focused level and wants to strengthen their Business Analysis skills through practical project experience. The successful candidate will be curious, dependable, detail\-oriented, and confident working across business, development, and QA teams.
 


* If you enjoy bringing clarity to requirements and helping delivery teams turn business needs into working solutions, we would be happy to hear from you

**Title And Summary**
 Business Analyst II \- Product Owner
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 Business Analyst II – Technical (Product Owner) L8
   

  

**Overview**
 The UK product team is looking for a Product Owner to join the team working on UK domestic clearing products driving forward enhancements to these products and developing/shaping the requirements for new additional products and services that will leverage the current platforms. The ideal candidate is passionate about working in complex change environment with well established/mature products and services.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 A Product Owner is responsible for maximizing the value of the product by managing and prioritizing the backlog to align with business goals and customer needs. They act as the key liaison between stakeholders and the delivery team, ensuring requirements are clearly defined and understood. They also make decisions on scope and priorities to guide the team toward delivering the most valuable outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Owns the working backwards document and vision for feature releases
* Identifies gaps and charters new platform capabilities as required
* Makes use of research, user studies, metrics and competitive analysis to understand the platform and business needs for a platform product
* Compares features for competitive review to inform prioritization within a platform product release


 Identifies innovations or performs test and learn experiments to create features that add more business and customer value for a platform product
   

  

* Participates with the business in customer research to inform platform product feature needs
* Contributes near\-term input (quarterly) for the platform product portfolio and roadmap
* Makes trade\-off decisions on platform product features
* Uses runtime metrics of their services in market as a feedback loop in to the backlog and balances the priorities against new feature requests
* Exhibits expertise within platform feature area and coordinates with interdependent teams
* Digests business customer requirements (user stories, use cases) and platform requirements for a platform feature set
* Has visibility into the design of the user experience
* Determines release goals for the platform and prioritizes assigned features according to business and platform value, adjusting throughout implementation as needed
* Continuously monitors feature development at the feature level
* Reviews product demo with the development team against acceptance criteria for the feature set
* Prepares launches and monitors platform performances, adoption, and operational health for feature sets
* Stays aligned with GTM plans for the feature set
* Identifies issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirements and communicates to leadership
* Supports and participates in post\-launch reviews and ensures feedback is reincorporated into the feature
* Works with internal teams and customer service to identify, classify, and prioritize feature\-level customer issues
* Develops and implements new metrics into measurement techniques; works with development teams to develop reports to monitor them
* Independently identifies and researches anomalous performance; escalates findings to senior management
* Coordinates internal forums to collect and identify feature\-level development opportunities
* Owns and manages product documentation; enables self\-service support and/or works to reduce overhead
* Identifies feature risks from business and customer feedback and in\-depth analysis of operational performance; shares with senior leadership
* Establishes a network within the organization; begins to build internal and external networks
* Mentoring team members
* Assists with candidate selection and onboarding
* Experienced PO with proven track record working in financial services
* Understanding and experience of UK payment domestic clearing products/services, i.e. Bacs or Real time (FPS) payments
* Experienced in producing business requirements specification documents
* Be skilled performing the elicitation and analysis of business change, functional and non\-functional requirements across a range of stakeholders, internal and external


 Strong analysis and problem solving skills
   

  

* Excellent communication skills and able to communicate both written and verbally to internal stakeholders and external clients


**Required Skills By Mastercard (7\)**
* Agile Development
* Architecting Solutions
* Consulting \& Strategic Judgment
* Customer Needs and Insights
* Organisational Design
* Requirements Gathering
* Technical Documentation


**Competencies**
 Global Perspective (Intermediate); Future Focus (Intermediate); Commercial Focus (Intermediate); Business Acumen (Intermediate); Personal Influence (Intermediate); People Leadership (Foundational); Innovation and Thought Leadership (Foundational)
   

  

**All About You**
 Product Owner (PO) \- key experiences:
   

  

* Connecting with the Customer
* Be keenly aware of the needs of the people to whom the products are delivered.
* Understand and reflect the needs of non\-customer stakeholders who rely on the cadence and quality of the team’s output.
* Identify problems that customers want to be solved through different thinking tools, then identify the ‘jobs to be done’ that are most worth pursuing.
* Contributing to the Vision and Roadmap
* Regularly engage with Product Management to analyse market research and understand the business drivers that trigger work requests.
* Ensure that the vision and roadmap contain real value by representing the end user, their needs and experience of using the products.
* Assist with ART backlog prioritization by collaborating with key roles and stakeholders to guide the sequencing of features over time.
* Assist with communicating the vision and roadmap during planning events to ensure teams are aligned.
* Managing and Prioritizing the Team Backlog
* Guide story creation by ensuring they are well\-formed and aligned with product strategy, backlog refinement. Proven track record producing high quality user stories and acceptance criteria
* Clarify story details using product ownership tools and techniques such as user\-story voice, INVEST, and BDD.
* Prioritize backlog items by regularly ordering backlog items according to their cost of delay, and communicate the sequence to the team
* Accept stories by validating that stories meet their Definition of Done to assure that quality is built in.
* Support the Team in Delivering Value
* Balance stakeholder perspectives by receiving feedback and insights, understanding the drivers and collaborating with stakeholders and teams to make implementation decisions that produce the most favourable outcomes.
* Elaborate stories before and during the iteration to help the team increase velocity and shorten learning cycles.
* Attend and actively participate in team and ART events.
* Getting and Applying Feedback
* Mitigate the risk of developing solutions with little value by collaborating with Product Management to define benefit hypotheses that drive implementation.
* Obtain feedback from customers and stakeholders that indicates how well the solutions meet their needs.
* Share feedback with Product Management and System Architects.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Data Analyst - Senior
description:
As a Senior Data Analyst, measurement, you will be the analytical engine behind our commercial performance tracking. Serving within the Global Verticals Marketing team, you will act as the primary point of contact for querying, analysing, and synthesizing FedEx internal transactional and customer data. Your mission is to convert complex datasets into clear, actionable vertical performance narratives that guide business planning.
   

  

 In this role, you will build executive\-ready reports, conduct ad\-hoc analyses, and provide data\-driven insights that directly support marketing, commercial strategy, and forecasting functions. Your work will directly influence how senior leadership understands vertical health, product performance, and regional business dynamics.
   

  

**Grade : T5**
**"Please note that the Job will close at 12am on Posting Close date, so please submit your application prior to the Close Date"**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Vertical Performance
   

  

* Write, optimize, and execute complex SQL queries against FedEx enterprise data warehouses to extract performance metrics across priority industry verticals (e.g., E\-commerce, Healthcare, Aerospace, Technology).
* Monitor and analyse key commercial indicators, including volume, revenue, and yield, with a specific focus on identifying regional / lane / product level insights.
* Investigate regional and product\-level performance variations, isolating root causes of growth or decline and translating findings into structured data briefs.
* Build, maintain, and automate interactive performance dashboards and scorecards to track commercial performance, vertical health, and pipeline health.


 Executive \& Leadership Reporting
   

  

* Synthesize complex performance datasets into high\-impact, visual, and narrative\-driven reports for leadership and executive\-level business updates (e.g., CEO updates and strategic reviews).
* Translate analytical findings into concise executive takeaways, ensuring executive communications clearly explain the past performance, present status, and future outlook.
* Deliver regular monthly and quarterly performance updates, highlighting competitive risks, commercial opportunities, and customer journey trends.


 Strategic \& Forecasting Support
   

  

* Partner with forecasting, strategy, finance, and marketing functions to model commercial funnels, market demand shifts, and historical volume trends.
* Apply statistical techniques and behavioural segmentation models to track, isolate, and forecast changes in specific customer cohorts and industry verticals.
* Conduct rapid\-response, ad\-hoc deep dives to answer critical, time\-sensitive business questions posed by leadership.
* Provide data backing and baseline historical trends to support annual commercial strategic planning and commercial goal setting.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

 Experience \& Background
   

  

* 6\-10 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, sales analytics, or financial/commercial measurement roles.
* Proven experience querying large\-scale, complex relational databases to extract commercial, transactional, and customer\-level insights.
* Demonstrated track record of preparing executive\-calibre presentations, briefs, and reports based on complex data analysis.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional, global stakeholders across various time zones.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Executive Storytelling \& Visualization: The ability to translate numbers into a cohesive, executive\-ready story that leaders can grasp and act on instantly.
* Statistical Thinking \& Pattern Discovery: Strong capability to utilize business statistics (e.g., correlation, significance testing, regression, trend analysis) to


 robustly identify patterns, validate data anomalies, and extract high\-integrity insights from raw corporate data.
   

  

* Analytical Rigor \& Structured Problem Solving: High attention to data accuracy, methodological soundness, and the ability to formulate logical business hypotheses.
* Agility \& Proactiveness: Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, managing competing priorities, and delivering quick\-turnaround ad\-hoc analyses.


**Professional Expertise \& Technical Skills**
* Analytics \& BI: High proficiency in SQL (required) and experience working with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Teradata, or BigQuery).
* Applied Business Statistics: Practical knowledge of statistical methods to perform cohort analysis, customer segmentation, and behavioural pattern recognition to discover performance anomalies.
* Business AI \& Machine Learning Application: Understanding of how to leverage predictive models, clustering algorithms (e.g., for cohort refinement), and NLP/text mining to automate industry vertical tracking, spot micro\-trends, and optimize customer group definitions.
* Data Visualization: Proficiency in building dashboards in Power BI or similar BI tools
* Programming \& Automation: Comfortable using Python or R for statistical modelling, data manipulation, and analytical process automation is a must.
* Productivity \& Reporting: Expert\-level skills in MS Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables) and PowerPoint (to draft polished, executive\-ready presentations).


 Sector Familiarity: Prior experience analysing commercial performance within B2B verticals (e.g., Retail/E\-commerce, Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Industrial, Technology) is highly valued.
   

  

* Exposure to CRM/sales enablement tools (e.g., Salesforce)


 Certifications (nice to have)
   

  

* CFA, FRM, PMP, Six Sigma (or equivalent).


 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

description:

 A Day in the Life
   

  

 Our Global Diabetes Capability Center in Pune is expanding to serve more people living with diabetes globally. Our state\-of\-the\-art facility is dedicated to transforming diabetes management through innovative solutions and Technologies that reduce the burden of living with diabetes.
   

  

 This position is an exciting opportunity to work with Minimed’s Diabetes business. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investments to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care.

* Ensures that customer service and time objectives are achieved within existing financial constraints in order to meet marketing and financial objectives.

* Monitor KPIs including inventory accuracy, order cycle time, picking accuracy, warehouse utilization, and on\-time shipment performance.

title: Marketplace Account Manager (Ecommerce)
description:
ABOUT INVISEL
 
 Invisel is India's first nanotechnology\-based home surface protection brand. Our nano\-coatings create an invisible protective shield on home surfaces like glass, fabric, marble, leather, and tiles — protecting them from stains and damage for months. We are a fast\-growing D2C brand, and online marketplaces like Amazon and Flipkart are among our most important channels for reaching customers, driving revenue, and scaling the brand beyond our own website.
 



  




 THE ROLE
 
 We are looking for an E\-Commerce Marketplace Manager who owns Invisel's presence and performance across Amazon, Flipkart, and other relevant online marketplaces — end to end. This is not a listings\-and\-reporting role. This is an ownership role: you are responsible for how Invisel shows up, sells, and grows on every marketplace we operate on.
 



 You will work closely with the content team, performance marketing team, and operations/inventory teams — ensuring every listing is optimised, every campaign is executed on time, and every marketplace account stays healthy and growing.
 



 This role is for you if you have independently managed a brand's presence on Amazon, Flipkart, or another online marketplace before, understand how catalog, pricing, inventory, and advertising work together to drive marketplace sales, and can take full ownership of the numbers — not just the activity.
 



  




 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 
**▸ 1\. Marketplace Account Management** 




 ●      Manage the complete day\-to\-day operations of Invisel's Amazon and Flipkart accounts
 



 ●      Take end\-to\-end ownership of marketplace performance across all listed platforms
 



 ●      Monitor marketplace dashboards, notifications, account health, and performance metrics daily
 



 ●      Resolve listing errors, suppressed products, inventory issues, and other account\-related concerns quickly
 



 ●      Coordinate with marketplace support teams whenever required
 



 ●      Ensure full compliance with each marketplace's policies and guidelines
 



**▸ 2\. Sales \& Business Growth** 




 ●      Develop and execute strategies to grow marketplace sales month on month
 



 ●      Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance against targets
 



 ●      Analyse SKU\-level performance — identify what's working and what isn't, and act on it
 



 ●      Identify opportunities to improve visibility, traffic, and conversion across marketplaces
 



 ●      Own monthly and quarterly marketplace sales targets
 



**▸ 3\. Catalog, Listing \& Pricing** 




 ●      Manage and maintain accurate product listings — titles, descriptions, bullet points, images, and specifications
 



 ●      Coordinate with the content and creative teams for listing optimisation and marketplace\-specific creatives
 



 ●      Monitor competitor pricing and marketplace movements; maintain competitive, profitable pricing
 



 ●      Plan and execute marketplace promotions, deals, and coupon campaigns
 



 ●      Fix listing suppression, catalog errors, or incorrect categorisation as soon as they arise
 



**▸ 4\. Inventory \& Order Coordination** 




 ●      Coordinate with inventory and operations teams to maintain healthy, campaign\-ready stock levels across all marketplaces
 



 ●      Monitor SKU\-wise inventory and flag stock\-out or overstock risks early
 



 ●      Track order processing, cancellations, and returns, and resolve fulfilment issues with the relevant teams
 



  





**▸ 5\. Marketplace Advertising \& Campaigns** 




 ●      Coordinate with the performance marketing team on Amazon and Flipkart advertising
 



 ●      Provide SKU\-level insights to guide ad spend and campaign planning
 



 ●      Plan and coordinate participation in major marketplace sale events (e.g. Amazon Great Indian Festival, Flipkart Big Billion Days)
 



 ●      Ensure pricing, inventory, and listings are campaign\-ready ahead of every major sale event
 



  





**▸ 6\. Analytics \& Reporting** 




 ●      Prepare and share weekly and monthly marketplace performance reports — sales, orders, conversion, traffic, returns, and profitability
 



 ●      Maintain SKU\-level performance tracking across all marketplaces
 



 ●      Turn data into clear, actionable recommendations for the wider team
 



  




 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 
**▸ Background — Non\-Negotiable** 




 ●      2–4 years of hands\-on experience in e\-commerce marketplace management
 



 ●      Has independently managed Amazon and Flipkart seller/vendor accounts for a brand
 



 ●      Has previously owned marketplace performance for one or more brands independently — not just supported a larger team
 



 ●      Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills — comfortable working with SKU\-level data daily
 



  





**▸ Skills — Non\-Negotiable** 




 ●      Deep working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub operations
 



 ●      Understands how catalog, pricing, inventory, and advertising work together to drive marketplace sales — not siloed thinking
 



 ●      Strong analytical ability — reads marketplace data and draws clear, actionable conclusions
 



 ●      Clear communicator — coordinates confidently with content, creative, performance marketing, and operations teams
 



 ●      Organised — manages multiple SKUs, listings, and marketplace dashboards without dropping anything

The team partners with all client\-facing business units and corporate functions, as well as industry experts, to build transformational technology impacting investment banking, trading, sales, and research teams to drive revenue, maximize efficiency, and optimize client service.
   

  

 We are at the forefront of Jefferies' cloud initiative, leveraging best\-in\-class cloud\-based technologies to replace legacy on\-premises solutions to provide intelligent trend insights, actionable opportunities, decision support, and transparency into all client and business\-related activities.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As an AVP, Salesforce Engineer, you will be a hands\-on developer responsible for building and delivering features on the Salesforce platform within a heavily customized enterprise org. You will work within a global engineering team, picking up well\-defined work items, writing clean code that follows established framework patterns, and shipping reliably within sprint timelines. This role demands solid technical skills, attention to quality, and the ability to collaborate effectively across time zones.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Feature Development: Build functionality using Apex, LWC, and Flows within an existing custom framework \- following established component patterns, coding conventions, and metadata\-driven architecture.
* Builds feature end\-to\-end from technical spec through unit testing.
* Integration Support: Implement integration callouts using REST/SOAP APIs, Named Credentials, and Platform Events, working from defined contracts and adapter patterns established by senior engineers.
* Team Collaboration: Coordinate daily with distributed team members. Provide clear status updates, raise blockers early, and participate actively in sprint ceremonies. Respond to code review feedback constructively and quickly.
* Code Quality: Write well\-tested, bulkified Apex that respects governor limits. Achieve meaningful test coverage. Follow established Git workflows and deployment processes.
* Troubleshooting: Debug issues across Apex, LWC, and integration layers. Perform root\-cause analysis with support from senior engineers when needed. Fix defects with precision and minimal regression.


**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**
* 7\-11 years of relevant experience.
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II (preferred)
* Salesforce Certified JavaScript Developer I
* Salesforce Development (Custom Orgs): Worked in a customized Salesforce org with custom objects and Apex\-driven logic. Can read an existing codebase, understand the patterns in use, and deliver features that follow them consistently.
* Apex (Solid Execution): Writes triggers, batch Apex, Queueable jobs, and SOQL that respects governor limits and runs cleanly at scale. Understands and has solid grasp of bulkification and async processing.
* Lightning Web Components (Implementation): Builds LWC components from design specs using composition, custom events, wire adapters, and imperative Apex. Comfortable with JS/HTML/CSS and delivers clean, functional UI within existing component patterns.
* Integration (Build Against Contract): Has implemented REST callouts, worked with Named Credentials, parsed JSON responses, handled errors. Build adapters from a defined specification. Ships working integrations reliably.
* Data Model: Understands Salesforce object relationships, Custom Metadata Types, Permission Sets, and Sharing Rules. Can navigate a complex schema and write efficient SOQL across related objects. Working knowledge of sharing rules, FLS and able to navigate \& extend existing models correctly.
* Tooling \& Process: Proficient with IDE, Salesforce CLI, Git (branching, PRs). Works within Agile/Scrum. Communicates clearly — raises blockers early, responds to code review feedback quickly, ships within sprint timelines.


 Same Posting Description for Internal and External Candidates

**Key Responsibilities**
 Do you enjoy turning complex finance and operational data into practical forecasts?

 We're looking for a Software Engineer to:
   

  

* design and deliver forecasting capabilities for finance and operational use cases, including driver\-based planning, time series forecasting and scenario analysis
* build reusable analytics solutions across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, Databricks and Microsoft Azure
* develop data pipelines and analytical models using Python, PySpark and SQL, with clear controls for quality, reconciliation and lineage
* combine SAP actuals, master data, business drivers and external signals to create forecasts that are transparent, scalable and actionable
* work with finance, data and technology teams to translate planning questions into user stories, model assumptions and measurable outcomes
* support prototypes, testing, deployment, documentation and continuous improvement in an agile delivery environment


**The team**
 You'll be working in our Finance Technology team, helping finance and business teams make better planning decisions through trusted data, forecasting models and decision simulations. Our work connects SAP and non\-SAP data with cloud analytics capabilities, so colleagues can understand forecast drivers, compare scenarios and act with confidence. As part of this team, you'll play an important role in making forecasting solutions easier to reuse, monitor and improve across planning domains.
   

  

**Your Skills And Experience**
* you’re curious to explore how AI can improve how we build, deliver, and optimize workflows. You do this with sound judgment – validating outputs and aligning with policies, risk standards, and ethical use
* experience in analytics, forecasting, enterprise planning, data engineering or applied machine learning, ideally within a finance or enterprise technology environment
* hands on experience with SAP S/4HANA data and processes, especially actuals, master data and business drivers used in planning and analytics
* practical knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud, including planning models, versions, data actions, dashboards, stories and scenario analysis
* experience with SAP Business Data Cloud or comparable SAP data and analytics capabilities, including semantic modelling and data integration
* strong Python, PySpark and SQL skills, with the ability to build maintainable data preparation, feature engineering and analytical workflows
* experience using Databricks on Microsoft Azure, including notebooks, jobs or workflows, Spark, Delta based processing, MLflow or similar deployment practices
* understanding of forecasting concepts such as driver\-based planning, rolling forecasts, model validation, back testing and forecast accuracy, clear communication skills, with the ability to explain model assumptions, behaviour, limitations and outcomes to technical and non\-technical audiences


**Useful Additional Experience**
 It would be an advantage if you also have:
   

  

* experience with probabilistic forecasting, hierarchical forecasting, causal methods, optimisation or Monte Carlo simulation
* knowledge of model governance, data lineage, observability, continuous integration and continuous delivery, or infrastructure automation
* familiarity with SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Fiori, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure DevOps or Power BI
* experience developing reusable forecasting products or self\-service capabilities for multiple business units, markets or planning domains
